scenes.tagline: Loyalty stamp cards that live inside Nimiq Pay
scenes.tag: Nimiq Mini Apps Competition · Cycle II
scenes.vo: This is NimStamp. A loyalty stamp card that lives inside Nimiq Pay.

scenes.label: The problem
scenes.head: Small businesses want repeat customers. Loyalty tools were never built for them.

bullets.v: get lost, get forged, and tell the owner nothing.
charge monthly fees and need a POS integration a market stall will never have.
pay a merchant in NIM today and get nothing back for their loyalty.

scenes.vo: Small businesses live on repeat customers, but loyalty tools were never built for them. Paper cards get lost and forged. Loyalty apps charge monthly fees and need a point of sale. And customers who pay in crypto get nothing back.

scenes.label: The gap
scenes.head: Nimiq Pay has the wallet and the payments. It has no self-serve loyalty.

bullets.v: Work only at curated partner locations, onboarded one by one.
Any merchant, anywhere, sets up a card in 60 seconds. No approval, no integration.
Stamps arrive automatically with every NIM payment. Nothing to scan.
Every stamp is a real NIM payment on chain. Loyalty becomes a reason to pay in NIM.

scenes.vo: Nimiq Pay has the wallet and the payments, but its rewards only work at curated partner locations. NimStamp fills that gap: any merchant, anywhere, self-serve, in sixty seconds. And every stamp is a real NIM payment on chain.

scenes.head: Pay in NIM. Earn a stamp.
scenes.sub: The customer opens the café’s link inside Nimiq Pay and taps Pay. The wallet attaches a tagged memo, and the server matches the payment on the Nimiq blockchain.
scenes.vo: Here it is live. A customer opens the café's card link and taps Pay. Nimiq Pay shows the amount with a tagged memo. Once the payment is confirmed on the Nimiq blockchain, the stamp appears. No QR scanning, and nothing for the cashier to do.

scenes.head: Redeem with a signature.
scenes.sub: A full card unlocks Redeem. The wallet signs a message, the server verifies it, and a four-letter code appears for the cashier.
scenes.vo: When the card is full, the customer taps Redeem and signs a message with their wallet. The server verifies the signature and issues a four-letter code for the cashier.

scenes.head: Merchants sign in by QR.
scenes.sub: Scan the laptop’s QR with the phone that receives payments. No passwords, no accounts, no crypto knowledge needed.
scenes.vo: Merchants sign in on a laptop by scanning a QR code with the phone that receives their payments. No passwords, no accounts.

scenes.head: Confirm the reward.
scenes.sub: The dashboard lists customers, stamps and every payment with its on-chain link. One click confirms the code.
scenes.vo: The dashboard shows customers, stamps, and every payment linked to the chain. The cashier confirms the code, and the reward is done.

scenes.head: Public, verifiable stats.
scenes.sub: Live numbers for every business on NimStamp. Each stamp links to its transaction on nimiq.watch.
scenes.vo: Everything is public. The stats page shows live numbers, and every stamp links to its transaction on nimiq dot watch.

scenes.label: How it makes money
scenes.head: Free for every merchant. Paid for by the rewards it creates.

bullets.v: One card, unlimited customers and stamps. Free forever, so adoption is never blocked by price.
A small NIM fee on each redeemed reward, paid only when loyalty actually worked.
Multiple locations, staff logins, analytics and branded cards on a monthly NIM plan.
Every stamp is a NIM payment to a real merchant. More stamps, more NIM in circulation.

scenes.vo: Every merchant gets one card free forever, so price never blocks adoption. NimStamp earns a small NIM fee on each redeemed reward, and a Pro plan for chains adds locations, staff logins, analytics and branded cards. Every stamp is a NIM payment, so NimStamp grows the Nimiq economy as it grows.

scenes.footer: MIT licensed · Runs inside Nimiq Pay · NIM payments, message signing, device ID, language API
scenes.vo: Nimiq's built-in rewards work at partner locations. NimStamp lets any merchant, anywhere, set up loyalty in sixty seconds.
